description: This PHP source file defines the SurveysViewReports class extending SugarView, responsible for displaying survey report data within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for retrieving survey statistics, processing survey responses, and generating data visualizations for survey questions of various types. The class interacts with the database, linked beans, and template rendering components to produce comprehensive survey response reports.

classes.name: SurveysViewReports
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering survey report summaries and detailed response analytics within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: getSurveyStats
methods.description: Retrieves the count of sent survey responses and distinct respondents for a specific survey identified by the bean's ID.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to compile and render the survey report, including response statistics and question response analysis, into an HTML view.

methods.name: getCheckboxQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Initializes response data skeleton for checkbox-type survey questions.

methods.name: getMatrixQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Sets up response data structure for matrix-type questions with options.

methods.name: getChoiceQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Prepares response data for multiple-choice or single-choice questions.

methods.name: getRatingQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Creates a response skeleton for rating questions with a 1-5 star scale.

methods.name: getScaleQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Generates response data skeleton for scale questions ranging from 1 to 10.

methods.name: generateSkeletonData
methods.description: Generates the initial structure for survey question responses, tailored to question type.
